items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] With Peter Boyle? Yeah, I saw that.

ctx.x: Those people lived daringly. So I think it was just some extra-strong substance, where – as the movie Joe – did you ever see a movie called Joe?
With Peter Boyle? Yeah, I saw that.
As Joe would put it, they were having an orgee.
